environment: Node v20.20.1, single process, autocannon 50 connections x 10 s, client and server on the same 2-vCPU sandbox (numbers are relative, not absolute)
catalogue: 1,440 hotels / 4,339 room types (120 hotels per city, 12 cities), 35 % pre-sold inventory

runs.title: GET /search — 48 distinct popular queries (cache warm, SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_MS=30000)
GET /search — random dates/cities/guests with the cache disabled (SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_MS=0): full filter + availability + quote + rank + facets per request

takeaway: The LRU/TTL search cache lifts throughput 8.3x (1.1k -> 9.5k req/s) and cuts p50 latency 10x (41 ms -> 4 ms) on this box; the uncached handler itself runs in ~0.9 ms p50, the rest of the cold-path latency is queueing on a single thread.
